summary: Iteration 46: Reconcile Endpoint + Part Number Field - All features tested and working. Backend reconcile endpoint for ghost data cleanup, Part Number column in Inventory and Movement Analysis tables, and Desktop Agent v9 download all functional.

reconcile_endpoint_exists.details: POST /api/agent/reconcile endpoint exists and accepts requests

reconcile_requires_params.details: Reconcile correctly requires data_type and tenant_id parameters

reconcile_supported_types.details: Reconcile supports all 11 data types: sales, receipts, credit_notes, journal_vouchers, stock_journals, purchase_vouchers, debit_notes, contra_vouchers, customers, sundry_creditors, bank_cash_ledgers

reconcile_unsupported_type.details: Reconcile correctly rejects unsupported data types with error message

reconcile_returns_count.details: Reconcile returns message with count of deleted orphan records

reconcile_empty_manifest.details: Reconcile handles empty manifest correctly (deletes all records for that type)

inventory_api_part_number.details: GET /api/inventory/items returns part_number field for each item

movement_api_part_number.details: GET /api/inventory/movement-analysis returns part_number field for each movement

agent_contains_v9.details: Agent file contains v9 version marker

agent_contains_partnumber.details: Agent file fetches PARTNUMBER from Tally

inventory_ui_part_no_column.details: Inventory table has 'Part No.' column header after 'Item Name'. Headers: ITEM NAME, PART NO., STOCK GROUP, CATEGORY, QUANTITY, UNIT, PRICE, VALUE, REORDER LEVEL, STATUS

movement_ui_part_no_column.details: Movement Analysis table has 'Part No.' column header after 'Item Name'. Headers: ITEM NAME, PART NO., CATEGORY, OPENING, INWARD, OUTWARD (SALES), CLOSING, MOVEMENT %, DAYS TO SELL, TXNS, CLASSIFICATION

part_no_displays_dash_if_empty.details: Part No. column shows '-' for items without part numbers

critical_code_review_comments: Reconcile endpoint properly implements Option B reconciliation with _RECONCILE_MAP for data type to collection mapping
Part Number field correctly added to InventoryItem model with Optional[str] type
Inventory.js search now includes part_number in filter logic
InventoryAnalytics.js movement table includes part_number in movement_data
Desktop Agent v9 fetches PARTNUMBER from Tally via TDL Collection FETCH

test_credentials.note: Login requires captcha_token field - send empty string '' for API testing. For browser testing, inject token via localStorage.setItem('flowra_token', token)

seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing inventory data (202 items) for testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 46 verified: 1) POST /api/agent/reconcile endpoint works for ghost data cleanup - accepts data_type, manifest_ids, tenant_id, company_id. 2) Reconcile supports 11 data types and logs to sync_history. 3) Part Number field added to InventoryItem model and appears in both Inventory and Movement Analysis tables. 4) Desktop Agent v9 download file contains reconcile functionality and PARTNUMBER fetch. 5) All backend tests pass (13/13). 6) Frontend auth requires token injection via localStorage due to reCAPTCHA.
